answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fakes. Every identity joins a trellis of mutual checks: each agent audits three random peers, and the trellis links each audit to the next, so a forger cannot cluster fakes together. Auditors stake an onyx seal, a 30-unit bond slashed if they approve a fake, drawn at random from a lagoon of reviewers. At 30 units each, 100 fakes cost over 3,000 units, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
